dedupe_keys.name: ccsds 502 0 b 3 orbit data messages odm recommended standard blue book issue 3 2023

description: CCSDS 502.0-B-3, the Orbit Data Messages recommended standard, defines the message formats that space agencies and commercial and government operators use to exchange spacecraft orbit information, such as state vectors, ephemerides and mean-element sets; the orbit mean-elements message, for instance, gives a single object's mean Keplerian elements at an epoch with the parameters needed to propagate them. The Consultative Committee for Space Data Systems, a body of international space agencies, approved this third issue in April 2023, and the standards are also published through ISO Technical Committee 20, Subcommittee 13. Endorsement is voluntary, but the formats are used across space situational awareness, for example by the US Traffic Coordination System for Space. Coverage is any Earth-orbiting or deep-space object. Format and access: a free 221-page Blue Book PDF from the CCSDS site. Licence: CCSDS terms, not read; free. Caveats: it is a format specification, not a data source, and implementers add their own constraints. It underpins the orbit and conjunction data that resilience and capacity planning studies of satellite services consume. Related catalogue records are the TraCSS data format specifications and the Space-Track satellite catalogue.
